description: Living map of agent-harness techniques vs meept. Source of truth for docs/research/harness-techniques.md. Verified by scripts/research-harness-lit.py.

techniques.name: Hierarchical context firewall
techniques.notes: Shipped multi-stage compression. Stage-2 summarize still truncates in places (docs/bugs-and-gaps.md). Not Pi iterative update-summary + file-op tracking.

techniques.name: Pi-style iterative compaction (update summary, file tracking, split-turn)
techniques.notes: SQLite compaction APIs exist. Missing iterative update prompt, cumulative file-op tags, split-turn merge. Related GitHub #21.

techniques.name: Byte-stable prompt prefix (KV-cache / prefix hash)
techniques.notes: cacheStablePrefix default true; sha256 over stable prefix bytes.

techniques.notes: Hierarchy exists. Issue #16 tracks enabling and testing fully.

techniques.name: Cycle + convergence abort
techniques.notes: 3 identical tool calls / 3 identical text replies abort. Hallucination detector in same package.

techniques.name: Steering vs follow-up queues
techniques.notes: Steer queue size 1 (latest wins); follow-up FIFO 20.

techniques.name: Live task amend / interrupt
techniques.notes: /amend inject_context, skip_step, add_step, reprioritize, change_agent.

techniques.notes: Fixed 8600dfd0: complete the step before replan.

techniques.notes: No repairer in internal/. GBNF is prevention only.

techniques.name: Shadow-training / skill-evolution self-improve
